description: METHODOLOGY FOR OPTIMIZING MASTER PLANS THROUGH GIS AND BIM INTEGRATION IN UZBEKISTAN'S URBAN PLANNING PRACTICE is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Shukurova Muhlisa To'lqinjon qizi, Worldly Knowledge Publishing Centre. This article provides an in-depth analysis of the methodology for integrating Geographic Information Systems (GIS) and Building Information Modeling (BIM) technologies in the development of urban planning documentation and master plans for cities in Uzbekistan. Coverage: national (UZ); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
